symptom: Repair v43 passed partial candidate validation, materialization, full-pack preflight, static balance budget, playable content coverage audit, GameCore validate-content, and isolated validate-candidates, but failed the 300s / 3-seed all-Bot smoke matrix. RouteBot stayed too high at 66.7% against a 10%-35% target, and ZoneControlBot rose to 66.7% against a 25%-55% target. IdleBot, RandomBot, CowardBot, GreedyXpBot, KiteBot, TankBot, and BossHunterBot remained inside target.
root_cause: The v43 repair only split the 225-300 second segment and raised licorice-skipper and sugar-moth weights during 225-255 seconds. This was too weak and too late to break RouteBot's two stable winning seeds: both still reached 300 seconds at level 6 after completing rainbow-candy-shot upgrades before the pressure window. The extra flank/control enemies also gave ZoneControlBot enough compatible targets and pacing to improve from 1/3 to 2/3, showing that a mild enemy-pool shift in this window is not a clean anti-route lever.
fix: Do not promote v43 into accepted_content, Runtime content, simulated_candidates, or playtest_candidates. Keep v38 as the current BossHunter-repaired base until a candidate passes the all-Bot smoke matrix. For the next repair, avoid small 225-255 enemy-pool-only shifts. Use a more direct but still narrow content-side lever, such as a short pre-Boss or Boss-entry pressure adjustment that affects RouteBot before it stabilizes after full rainbow-candy-shot, or a specific enemy behavior/weight change that does not feed ZoneControlBot's preferred control pacing.
validation: v43 reports are in harness/reports/2026-06-02_demo_buildcraft_repair_v43_* and the failed smoke matrix is harness/reports/2026-06-02_demo_buildcraft_repair_v43_matrix_300s_3seed_71000_001/summary.md. The same matrix shows IdleBot 0/3, RandomBot 0/3, CowardBot 1/3, GreedyXpBot 1/3, KiteBot 2/3, TankBot 1/3, and BossHunterBot 2/3 passing, but ZoneControlBot 2/3 and RouteBot 2/3 outside target. The next candidate must rerun the same 71000-71002 all-Bot smoke matrix and should be rejected if RouteBot remains 2/3 or another Bot is pushed outside target.
